---
title: "Central Limit Theorem"
format: html
params:
  experiment_path: "experiments/probability/central-limit-theorem"
  seed: 123
---

## Goal
Demonstrate convergence of sample-mean distributions.

## Inputs
```{r}
set.seed(params$seed)
path <- file.path(params$experiment_path, "outputs", "clt-sample-means.csv")
dat <- read.csv(path)
head(dat)
```

## Method
Repeated sampling from an exponential source distribution.

## Results
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(dat, aes(x = sample_mean)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~ n, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Sampling Distribution of Means")
```

## Interpretation
Higher sample sizes produce narrower and more symmetric mean distributions.

## Reproducibility Notes
Run `run.R` first, keep seed fixed, and use relative paths.

## Next Steps
Compare with normal and Bernoulli source distributions.
